jobs.description:
Millions of people wear Pandora to say something about themselves. Behind that sit two of the biggest levers on the company's results: a marketing investment among the largest in the industry, and the profitability of the jewellery itself.

You will build and run its engine keeping the Product and Marketing finance team connected to the financial heartbeat of the company: one planning calendar, one reporting standard, cost control across worldwide envelopes, and an automation toolchain that makes reporting produce itself. You are shaping how this team runs, and the role grows as the toolchain does. As we build the team capabilities, we continue delivering results every quarter, budget every autumn, and the value optimization discipline that funds our growth.

This is a role for someone who is a pace setter, taking real pride in a rhythm that builds credibility, and who wants to modernize how the work gets done.

**What You Will Do

**

• Own the Product and Marketing financial planning calendar end to end: budget and long-range planning milestones, forecast cycles, month-end and performance review inputs, orchestrating and collaborating so that every corporate deadline is met reliably and consistently.

• Own the reporting catalogue with clear service levels, and build the automation toolchain that produces the recurring suite, retiring manual production as you go.

• Run the functional line into our Global Business Services team: process catalogue, quality, capacity, one blueprint.

• Run cost control for the CMO, CPO and Global Office envelopes as a trusted, independent service.

• Front the team's interface to FP&A and the CFO office, reconciling to one set of definitions.

**What Is Needed To Succeed

**

• 7-10 years in financial planning, reporting or control; you have run a planning calendar or close process end to end.

• Experience building or running a shared-services or offshore interface, with the catalogue and quality rhythm to show for it.

• At least one recurring reporting process you automated, with the manual version retired, and genuine energy for doing it again at scale.

• The independence to hold deadlines, definitions and spend hygiene, including with colleagues more senior than you.

**Who You Are

**

• A self-starter: you see the missing process and build it before anyone asks.

• You develop and defend your own point of view: the calendar and the definitions are yours, and you can say no and make it stick, respectfully.

• You believe finance is a strategic copilot to the business, and control done well, an essential guardrail to earn investors' and consumers' trust.

• You can have difficult conversations respectfully, and colleagues trust you more because of them.

• Consumer-centric at heart: you keep the numbers connected to the people who wear the jewellery.

• People-first and collaborator: you make a shared-services team feel like one team, across sites and time zones.

Reporting into the Sr Director, Global Product & Marketing Finance, you will be the backbone of a small, senior team with a mandate from the top of the company, and you contribute by making excellent work systematic.

**Additional Information

**Global Career Band 4B - Manager.

Hybrid Working Flexibility – 3 days in office per week

Location Copenhagen; Global scope.

English is our working language; Danish is not required.

Did we get your attention?   We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com.

Icing on the cake

You will be working out of our beautiful Head Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. Besides our beautiful interior design, we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable and inspirational – and delivers a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

At Pandora, we believe that creating an inclusive and diverse workplace and reflecting societal diversity in our customer engagement is essential to delivering on our company purpose: to give a voice to people’s loves. We dedicate ourselves to fostering, cultivating and preserving a culture of inclusion and diversity where everyone feels respected and valued.

With an IoT platform connecting more millions of devices, and growing - Trackunit is building the connectivity layer underneath the construction industry. Every one of those units carries a cellular radio, and every one of those radios sits inside a web of standards, type approvals, and patent licences that decides whether we can ship and where we can ship.

You will join our IoT Division, Device Reliability Engineering (DRE) team as an expert on IoT certifications, standards, and licensing including Standard Essential Patents (SEP). This position shapes both our exposure and our coverage arguments, and it means this role works in every direction at once, with suppliers, regulatory approvals, legal advisors, product and engineering, and with customers.

This is a role for someone who can hold a genuinely complex domain in their head and then explain it in three sentences to a customer who has never heard the phrase “patent exhaustion.”

Experience level: a deep specialist role. We expect solid, hands-on experience with cellular device approvals and licensing — likely 10+ years across regulatory, certification, or IP/licensing work in mobile, IoT, or telecom hardware. This is a senior individual contributor position with no direct reports, high autonomy, and direct executive visibility.

With locations in the heart of Copenhagen, Kolding, Aarhus, and Aalborg, we offer a flexible setup with the possibility to work from one of our locations — or remotely from anywhere in Denmark.

****What's in it for you?

• A domain you will own, not administer. IoT Cellular License, SEP and certification strategy is an executive-level topic at Trackunit right now, with real financial exposure attached. You will not be filing paperwork in a corner, you will be shaping the position the company takes.

• International environment with regular check-ins and social events across teams, departments and borders.

• We take your personal and professional development goals seriously and we support them through training, coaching, and mindfulness as well as with an open feedback culture to enable you to identify your strengths and opportunities.

• Flexibility and hybrid working is not just a cliché to us or something we state in a job posting. We offer a flexible setup because we believe you know best how to structure your work. Once you have chosen how you work best, let us know what you need: we got you covered with the IT equipment you need for your work.

• Turning the Tide. At Trackunit, we aim to create and contribute to an inclusive workplace. And this priority starts with our hiring — we do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity, sexual orientation, personal expression, ethnicity, religious belief, or disability status. We only assess candidates on their qualifications and merit. Learn more about TIDE and other DE&I initiatives here.

****What you'll do

****Your work splits roughly into four parts: licensing, approvals, guidance, and governance.

• Own our SEP position. Understand where our cellular SEP exposure actually sits across our device portfolio, track the relevant patent pools and licensing programmes, and maintain a clear, evidence-based view of what is covered through our supply chain and what is not.

• Run supplier licensing due diligence. Establish and maintain a consistent set of asks across module suppliers — coverage confirmation, standards and generations covered, and honest disclosure of known gaps — so responses can be compared side by side and fed into supplier qualification.

• Support licensing negotiations and claims. Work alongside our General Counsel, external patent counsel, and economic advisors on royalty basis questions, valuation and apportionment arguments, and claims that reach us through our OEM customers. You bring the technical and supply chain substance; they bring the legal strategy.

• Own global type approvals and certification. Plan and steer RED/CE, FCC, ISED, UKCA, and the wider set of regional approvals, plus GCF/PTCRB and carrier certification, across a multi-region device portfolio. Keep certification on the critical path of new product programmes rather than at the end of them.

• Stay ahead of regulatory change. Cyber Resilience Act, RED delegated acts, radio spectrum and network sunsets, environmental and product compliance requirements — know what is coming, when it bites, and what it means for our roadmap.

• Make the complex simple, and guide without over-promising. Write and maintain the internal playbooks, customer-facing explainers, and OEM guidance that turn this domain into something a commercial colleague or a customer can act on. Be the person Sales, Legal, and customers come to when a licensing notification lands, explaining the landscape accurately, saying clearly where the limits of our position are, and pointing customers to independent specialist advice where that is the right answer.

• Build the governance. Response protocols, decision records, escalation paths, and embedding licensing and compliance requirements into how we qualify suppliers and run the product development lifecycle.

****Who you are

****We think you'll need

• Strong working knowledge of cellular connectivity (e.g. LTE-M, NB-IoT, LTE Cat-1/1bis, 5G) and the direction of travel, plus a real understanding of the module and chipset landscape.

• Solid, practical experience with licensing and Standard Essential Patents in mobile or IoT devices: FRAND principles, patent pools, patent exhaustion and the limits of sublicensing, and how royalties are actually structured and argued.

• Hands-on experience with global type approvals and regulatory certification for radio products — RED/CE, FCC, and the regional approvals that come with selling hardware worldwide.

• Experience working across a hardware supply chain with module suppliers, test houses, notified bodies, and certification partners.

• Communication as a core skill, not a bonus. You can take a genuinely complicated subject and land it in plain language, in writing, with an audience that has no background in it.

• The judgement to know what we can and cannot say to a customer, and the discipline to hold that line even when it would be easier not to.

**What Matters More Than The Checklist

**

• You are honest about uncertainty. In this domain, no one can offer a blanket guarantee, and the people who claim otherwise create problems later. We would rather be accurate than reassuring.

• You are curious and self-driven, this is a field that changes constantly, and nobody is going to hand you a reading list.

• You finish things. A clear one-page answer delivered this week beats a perfect analysis that arrives after the decision was made.

• You are comfortable being the only person in the room who knows a subject, and you use that position to make others smarter rather than to make yourself indispensable.

On AI: experience with AI tooling is not a requirement, but a strong motivation and interest in working with it is. We already use AI in our daily engineering work, including MCP servers and agents against our own platform, and we see clear potential in applying it to research, documentation, and compliance workflows. We don't expect you to have experience with this but we do expect curiosity and a willingness to learn.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries this is what we're looking for ideally, but if you're excited about this role and your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we still encourage you to apply.

****How you'll grow here

****This is a specialist role with an unusually wide view of the business, and we've set it up that way on purpose.

• Executive proximity. You will work closely with the SVP of IoT Division, while reporting into a central function for IoT, as the Device Reliability Engineering. You will help in presenting to executive leadership on exposure, risk, and recommendations. Your analysis will inform on a product technical matter (Not Legal) but with real financial and commercial decisions.

• Cross-functional reach. Legal, Finance, Product Management, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Sales all depend on this domain. Few roles at Trackunit touch as many parts of the company.

• External network. You will work with external patent counsel, economic consultants, module suppliers, certification bodies, and industry forums — building a network that extends well beyond Trackunit.

• Room to define the function. This discipline is being built out now. What it becomes — and whether it grows into a team — is substantially yours to shape.

**Coming Together To Connect Construction

**We're committed to construction one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products — it's a way of life at Trackunit. We're proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues get together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do it to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

Pack Tech, a packaging company founded in Denmark in 1946, is looking for a Quality Assurance Specialist to join our Quality team at our headquarters in Hellerup.

We develop and supply packaging solutions primarily for the beauty and personal care industry and work with manufacturing partners across Asia and Europe. We are also the company behind Ocean Waste Plastic (OWP), our own initiative for collecting and recycling ocean- and river plastic waste.

About the role

As our Quality Assurance Specialist, you will become part of a Quality team and report directly to the Head of Quality. You will work closely with the Head of Quality and Quality Assistants, as well as colleagues across Sales, Purchasing, Logistics and Product Development at our Danish headquarters.

You will also collaborate closely with our colleagues at our office in China and with manufacturing partners in both Asia and Europe.

The role has a strong focus on maintaining and developing our Quality Management System, supplier qualification, complaint and CAPA handling, audits, and ensuring that quality requirements are properly implemented and documented throughout our supply chain.

As Pack Tech operates in a fast-moving and customer-focused environment, an important part of the role is being able to balance solid QA processes with a practical and service-minded approach.

Your primary responsibilities

Your responsibilities will include:

• Maintaining and continuously improving our ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 Quality and Environmental Management Systems, including audits, procedures & records.

• Managing supplier qualification and ongoing supplier evaluation and audits, including QA and documentation related to relevant packaging requirements.

• Handling customer complaints, including CAPA and 8D processes, in cooperation with colleagues and manufacturing suppliers.

• Coordinating customer audits of Pack Tech, including preparation, participation and follow-up.

• Managing customer supplier qualification of Pack Tech, including questionnaires, documentation requests and follow-up.

• Working closely with our China office on supplier quality, quality documentation and follow-up with manufacturing suppliers.

Who you are

We are looking for someone with experience or education within Quality Assurance, Quality Management or a related field.

You do not necessarily need to come from the packaging industry, but you should be comfortable working systematically with quality processes and documentation.

We expect that you:

• Have experience with ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 QMS processes.

• Have a strong understanding of QA principles such as supplier qualification, audits, non-conformities, root cause analysis and CAPA.

• Are structured and comfortable working with procedures and documentation without losing sight of practical business needs.

• Have strong written and spoken English skills and communicate confidently with customers, suppliers and colleagues across the world.

Experience with packaging, plastics, PPWR or other regulatory requirements affecting packaging is an advantage but not a requirement.

The practicalities

The position is based at our headquarters in Hellerup (Greater Copenhagen), Denmark. Full-time presence in the office is expected, as the role involves close collaboration across departments.

Some travel should be expected in connection with audits with manufacturing suppliers in Europe.

We are looking to fill the position as soon as possible, so please apply today.

For questions about the position, please contact Head of Quality Ann Sofie Gade at ans@packtech1946.com.

As part of our continued growth, Application Development is expanding significantly. We are strengthening our department with two Lead Developers and five Senior Developers, creating exciting opportunities to join a growing team and help shape the future of software development at Nordic RCC.

Design, develop, and maintain robust applications using C# and .NET, while promoting consistent standards, code quality, maintainability and operational stability

• 
Contribute to improving system architecture by identifying areas for technical refinement, refactoring, or modernization

• 
Collaborating across the organization, represent Application Development by collaborating with Product Owners, Delivery Management, testers, Quality Management and other departments

•

• 
Connect technical expertise across teams and applications, enabling collaboration on dependencies, common challenges and reusable solutions

•

jobs.description:
Step into a role where commercial insight meets strategic impact. If you are passionate about understanding customer needs, identifying new growth opportunities and shaping the future of one of the most important product categories in VELUX, you could be our next Commercial Product Manager.

Meet your future team

You will join the Sloped Roof Windows Category team at our Head Office in Hørsholm. The team plays a central role in shaping the future of our largest and most important product category, working at the intersection of customer needs, innovation, strategy and commercial performance.

Collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. You will work closely with colleagues across Sales, Marketing, Product Development, Finance, Supply Chain, Operations and regional organisations around the world. Together, we translate market opportunities and customer insights into product portfolio decisions that drive sustainable and profitable growth.

The team is characterised by a high level of ambition, an informal and collaborative culture, and a shared commitment to creating meaningful business impact.

What We Offer

This is not a traditional product management role focused on maintaining an existing portfolio. Instead, you will play a key role in identifying where future growth will come from, shaping strategic choices and mobilising the organisation to bring them to life.

You will gain exposure across our international business, collaborate with senior stakeholders and influence decisions with significant commercial impact. In return, you will have the opportunity to grow professionally while helping shape the future of healthy, comfortable and sustainable living.

More specifically, your tasks will be to:

• Identify and develop growth opportunities across products, solutions, customer segments and markets

• Translate customer, market and commercial insights into portfolio recommendations and compelling business cases

• Strengthen value propositions, positioning, pricing and category differentiation to improve commercial performance

• Drive portfolio priorities, product launches and strategic category initiatives in close collaboration with regional and functional stakeholders

You should expect some travel, both within Denmark and internationally, to engage with customers, markets and colleagues across our global organisation.

What You Will Bring

You are commercially minded, customer-focused and motivated by complex business challenges. You enjoy connecting strategic thinking with practical execution and thrive in environments where collaboration, influence and analytical thinking are key to success.

You know how to turn insights into action, create alignment among diverse stakeholders and move initiatives forward. Most importantly, you are motivated by delivering meaningful business results and helping shape the future direction of a category.

Moreover, we expect that you:

• Bring experience from product management, category management, business development, commercial strategy or a comparable role, ideally within an international organisation

• Have strong commercial and analytical capabilities and can build robust business cases based on data, customer understanding and sound judgement

• Are skilled at influencing decisions, communicating recommendations clearly and creating alignment across functions and organisational levels

• Work in a structured and proactive manner, balancing multiple priorities while driving initiatives forward with ownership and energy

Experience from building materials, construction, durable goods, consumer products or another product-oriented industry is an advantage, but not a requirement. We are equally interested in candidates who bring a fresh commercial perspective and can apply it successfully within our business.

Ready to apply?

Learn more about the VELUX Group online at www.velux.com where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect from our recruitment process.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have found the right match.

All inquiries will be treated confidentially.

In the VELUX Group, we offer you a world of opportunities and the chance to create a bright future. From the forefront of the roof window category, we enable those who live, work and play under the roof to transform their spaces and live a healthier everyday life with more daylight and fresh air.

The VELUX Group is an international, family-owned business with strong financial roots and each year we create real impact by reinvesting in society, our employees and planet through our foundations. Alongside the rest of our values, courage and mutual respect define our actions every day and how we wish to contribute to the world.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all, whether you are applying for a role or already part of VELUX. We value diversity and strive to ensure that our employment decisions are fair and inclusive, focusing only on what truly matters: your qualifications and how you can contribute to our shared mission and success.

jobs.occupation: Excellence & Engagement Manager - Health, Safety & Security
jobs.description:
Do you want to be a valued part of a global team that works passionately every day to ensure employees at DFDS go to work for DFDS and return safely and unharmed home to their loved ones? If this excites you then look no further and come join us.

About The Role  Be part of the movement - and play your part.   As Excellence & Engagement Manager in the Global Health, Safety & Security Team, you will be part of the continuous strengthening of DFDS’ health, safety and security culture. This is a new global role, and we expect you to participate in shaping and developing it. We anticipate that you will contribute by developing, implementing and continuously improving the frameworks, standards, tools, learning processes, communications and engagement activities that enable a strong Health, Safety & Security (HSS) performance across DFDS landside operations.

You will be responsible for ensuring consistent and effective deployment of group-wide HSS initiatives across DFDS operations area, supporting operational teams in anchoring safe and secure behaviors. The role works closely with the HSS Business Partners, other operational stakeholders and senior management to strengthen organizational learning, capability, culture and performance.

The role reports directly to the Global Director for HSS, and you will be based at our Global Headquarters in the port of Copenhagen. The role requires on-site presence.

What kind of exciting challenges can you expect to meet in this role?:  **Role

**As Excellence & Engagement Manager - HSS you will get the opportunity to influence and develop the role but the initial areas we expect you to cover are:

• Develop, coordinate and monitor global HSS initiatives.

• Develop, coordinate and maintain global HSS culture-building activities, campaigns and engagement programs aiming to strengthen safe and secure behaviors.

• Maintain and continuously improve our HSSEQ Management System.

• Develop, implement and continuously improve a Managers Toolkit on HSS.

• Manage Performance Monitoring and Improvement related to HSS in close collaboration with HSS Business Partners.

• Develop and coordinate DFDS’ organizational learning processes on HSS, ensuring learnings from incidents, audits etc. are translated into practical improvements and shared across the organization.

• Support leadership teams in understanding and applying HSS frameworks, standards and improvement methodologies.

• Build strong working relationships with operational leaders, local HSS teams, and functional stakeholders.

About You We think that the strongest teams are built on diversity and inclusivity. Contrasting opinions, varied skills and strong characters bring out the best in us all. With this in mind, we think that you are passionate about health, safety & security, have excellent interpersonal and communication skills, are a good listener and can digest large amounts of information and convert it into actions.

You Are Structured, Self-supporting And Capable Of Both Prioritizing And Multitasking In a Demanding Environment. Moreover, We Imagine That The Ideal Candidate Brings

• Ability to think strategically, translating HSS strategy into practical solutions and measurable business outcomes.

• A passion for building a strong HSS culture through engagement, communication and leadership influence.

• Experience in developing and implementing standards, frameworks and management systems within operational environments.

• Natural collaboration skills, with the ability to build relationships and influence without direct authority.

• Strong organizing skills, bringing structure, governance and consistency to complex initiatives.

• Capability to operate between strategy and execution, balancing long-term objectives with day-to-day deliveries, in a global corporate function.

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, good listening abilities, and the ability to digest large amounts of information and convert it into actions.

• A self-driven approach, with the ability to prioritize and multitask in a demanding environment.

**Furthermore, You Have

**

• A degree in business, organizational development, safety or security management, or related field.

• Proven experience (5+ years) within safety or security related functions in a global or matrixed organization.

• Experience in shipping, logistics, or industrial sectors is highly desirable.

• Strong understanding of safety/security culture principles and organizational behavior is an advantage.

• Excellent presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.

• Knowledge of or certification in change management methodologies is a plus.

• Project management certification (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2) is an advantage.

• Proficiency in English (oral and written) as English is corporate language.

• Proficiency in Microsoft 365 suite.

• Experience in utilizing AI tools is an advantage.

Working at DFDS  Join the movement and grow with us.  While you’re with us, we want you to develop and move yourself on. We’ll encourage you to challenge yourself to acquire new skills and perspectives.

At DFDS, we promote a great workplace with a diverse and vibrant community. At our Copenhagen headquarters, we enjoy a modern workspace with award-winning facilities, different work zones, own game room, fitness facilities, canteen and a café with a rooftop terrace with a beautiful ocean view, all just 5 minutes from the nearest train & metro station.

Are we a match? Then what are you waiting for? Apply Now.   If you think your personality, skills, experience and aspirations match this role, we’d love to hear from you. Send us your resume as soon as possible as we’re keen to meet potential candidates on an ongoing basis.

Is there something you need to know, we haven’t covered here, please do not hesitate to reach out to Global Director HSS (Landside) Steffen Conradsen on sconr@dfds.com.

Please note that response times may be slightly longer than usual due to the autumn holiday period and business travel activities within the hiring team, however, rest assured that we will get back to you at earliest convenience.

We look forward to hearing from you.   This recruitment process is managed by the DFDS Talent Acquisition team. We kindly ask external recruitment agencies to refrain from contacting us regarding this opportunity.
